problem: is_empty was simplified from a three-branch check to `lo >= hi`, so any closed single-point interval (lo == hi with both bounds closed) is now always treated as empty, silently dropping or corrupting results in normalize, union, intersection, and difference.
suggested_fix: Restore the lo==hi branch distinguishing closed from non-closed endpoints, e.g. `return lo > hi or (lo == hi and not (lo_closed and hi_closed))`.

problem: is_empty lost its self-documenting three-branch structure and has no docstring/comment explaining the point-interval emptiness rule, unlike other non-trivial methods in the file.
suggested_fix: Add a short docstring once the logic is fixed, e.g. "A degenerate [x, x] interval is empty unless both ends are closed."
